# classmcp

> classmcp is a local, open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that connects coding agents (Codex, OpenCode, Claude Code, Cursor, and any stdio MCP host) to a student's Google Classroom account. It lists due, missing, new, and graded work, reads assignments, searches coursework, downloads Drive attachments, and makes best-effort submissions. It runs on the user's computer with the user's own Google OAuth Desktop credentials. No hosted backend, no telemetry. npm package `gcrclassmcp`, command `classmcp`, Node.js 20+.

Agents setting this up: fetch the complete guide below and follow its "Agent setup procedure". It contains host-specific instructions for Codex, OpenCode, and Claude Code. If you are any other host, you must read your own host's MCP documentation before registering the server.

Quick start:

```
npm install --global gcrclassmcp@next
classmcp setup      # interactive: stores Google OAuth Desktop credentials, opens consent
classmcp doctor     # ok/warn/fail diagnostics, no secrets printed
classmcp serve      # stdio MCP server, started by the host
```

## Docs

- [Complete setup, tools, and troubleshooting for agents](https://khurrambhutto.github.io/classmcp/llms-full.txt): self-contained guide; read this to install, authorize, register with a host, verify, and fix problems
- [README](https://github.com/khurrambhutto/classmcp#readme): human-oriented documentation, source of truth if anything conflicts
- [Security policy](https://github.com/khurrambhutto/classmcp/blob/master/SECURITY.md): reporting process

## Project

- [Source repository](https://github.com/khurrambhutto/classmcp): TypeScript, MIT license

- [Issues](https://github.com/khurrambhutto/classmcp/issues): bug reports and help; include `classmcp doctor` output
